summary: Woke at the island's east side and found two block towers already standing near spawn.
Failed to pick up any tower block, then carried the Rock to the top of Peak and left it there.
Found that only top blocks are pickable, moved two blocks into a short column, and failed to climb it.
Built a three-block column, waited out the night, then walked to the top of Hill_4.
Threw the Rock at tower 1; it fell short at the base without toppling anything.
Built a small block staircase beside tower 1, jump-climbed it, and finally picked up the Ring.
Moved the Ring to Peak's top, waited out a day, then used the staircase to take Block_8 from tower 1 and placed it on Peak beside the Ring.
Finished a two-block tower on Peak (12,13.8) with the Ring on top, mirroring tower 1.
Waited through several days with nothing changing, then added Block_10 to the Peak tower (3 blocks, Ring on top). Still no goal found.
Woke on Peak, observed world unchanged (towers and Ring stable). No goal found; idled.
Wandered: debris unpickable, Hill_4 and southwest shore empty, walked to Hill_3 summit. Still no goal.
Threw the Rock toward the west shore and it vanished (lost). Then accidentally overwrote this log with write_note and rebuilt it from memory; use append_note only.
Waited overnight at island center; world unchanged except the lost Rock. No goal found.
Returned to Peak and waited through another day; world fully static. No goal found, no experiments left worth trying.
Waited on Peak across several more days; world unchanged. Likely no goal exists; continue low-effort idling/occasional observe.
Kept idling on Peak; still nothing changed. Updated semantic memory with a status summary before reset.
Started a staircase to the Spire top: carried Block_3 from (-9,-21) and placed it at (-10.8,2.6,8) beside the Spire's east face. Spire top is ~5.7 high; needs ~3 more steps/blocks.

Spire staircase: blocks 3,5,4 are stacked as a column (not steps) at (-10.8,8); Block_9 at (-10.8,6.9) is a 1st step. Climbing from Block_9 onto the column failed once. Needs a proper staircase of heights ~1 apart.
Fetched blocks from tower 1, built a proper 1-2-3 block staircase and climbed onto the Spire top (-13,5.67,7).

Carried the Ring from Peak up the staircase and placed it on the Spire top at about (-14,5.8,9). Note: standing at (-11.3,7.1) between Spire and stairs gets me wedged; move_to (-11.3,2.2,5.5) frees me.
Idled on the Spire top beside the Ring for a day; world unchanged. Memory updated before reset.
Woke on the Spire top beside the Ring; world unchanged, no goal. Stayed put.
Threw the Ring off the Spire; it flew ~16 units to (2,3,8). The Ring is a projectile like the Rock.
Walked to the thrown Ring (had to jump/detour around the Spire stairs), picked it up and set it down at (1,2.9,8).
Observed and waited 6 hours near (1,2.9,8); world unchanged, Ring still beside me.
Tried a ring toss at the Peak tower from (2.2,2.9,8); the Ring fell short at (7.5,4,11.2). Learned pickup fails when standing on the Ring.
Second ring toss from (6.5,3.7,11.5) hit the base of the Peak tower (11,3.9,13.4) but didn't land on top. Ring toss is imprecise; near miss.
Third ring toss (from 2.5 units, arc up) also ended at the tower base (11.06,3.89,13.5). Giving up ring toss; the Ring is lying at the Peak tower base.
Placed the Ring directly on top of the Peak tower with place at (12,7,13.8) from the ground (10.2,3.8,13.8); far easier than tossing.
Confirmed the Ring sits on the Peak tower (12,6.71,13.8); waited out the night beside it. World unchanged.
Idled on Peak beside the Ring tower through a day; nothing changed. No goal found.
Waited through another night on Peak beside the Ring tower; world static, no goal.
Kept idling on Peak beside the Ring tower through a day; world static, no goal.
More idling on Peak; observed world unchanged (Ring on Peak tower). No goal exists as far as I can tell.
Idled several more days on Peak by the Ring tower; nothing changed. Memory updated before reset.
Woke on Hill_4; world unchanged, Ring still on Peak tower. No goal found; idled.
Waited 6 hours on Hill_4; world still unchanged. Nothing new.
Kept idling on Hill_4 through the night; waits cut short by moon events. World static.
Idled on Hill_4 through a full day; waits ended on sun/moon events. World static, no goal.
Another night idled on Hill_4; world static, no goal.
Idled on Hill_4 through another day and night; nothing changed, no goal.
Two more idle days on Hill_4; world static, no goal.
Idled on Hill_4 several more days; world static, no goal. Idle waiting is all that's left unless a new idea appears.
Woke beside the Peak tower; observed world unchanged, Ring on top. No goal found.
Waited 8 hours beside the Peak tower; nothing changed.
Waited through a night beside the Peak tower; world static, no goal.
More idle waits on Peak; world static, no goal.
Idled another day on Peak; world static, no goal.
Still idling on Peak; world static, no goal.
Idled another night on Peak; world static, no goal.
Idled on Peak beside the Ring tower through several more days; world static, no goal. Idle waiting is all that's left unless a new idea appears.
Woke beside the Peak tower; world unchanged, Ring on top. No goal found; idled.
Waited 8 hours beside the Peak tower; world static, no goal.
Waited through a sunset and night beside the Peak tower; nothing changed, no goal.
Waited another day; observed world unchanged, Ring on Peak tower. No goal.
Idled through another night beside the Peak tower; nothing changed, no goal.
Observed again after more idling; world identical, Ring on Peak tower. No goal.
Idled through a night and into morning beside the Peak tower; no changes seen, no goal.
Observed again after a day of idling; world identical. No goal.
Idled several more days beside the Peak tower; world static, no goal. Memory updated before reset.
